finding.title: Total goes negative when the discount exceeds the sum

reject.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+package cart
+
+import (
+	"database/sql"
+	"fmt"
+)
+
+// Line is one cart line, priced in cents.
+type Line struct {
+	PriceCents int64
+	Qty        int64
+}
+
+// Total sums the lines and takes the discount off.
+func Total(lines []Line, discountCents int64) int64 {
+	var sum int64
+	for _, l := range lines {
+		sum += l.PriceCents * l.Qty
+	}
+	return sum - discountCents
reject.reply: Not a bug: checkout caps the discount at the cart total before it calls Total, so this never goes negative.
